title: CasePlan version envelope and revision profile
$comment: An envelope for immutable CasePlan versions. Consumers choose content and adequacy rules, validate referenced payloads, and enforce approval and lineage in context.

RevisionProfile.description: Reusable metadata for an immutable version of an information object. The enclosing object owns the version identity; metadata has no independent identity.

revisionNumber.description: Sequence within the applicable plan history, not a globally unique version ID.

previousRevision.description: Immediate derivation predecessor, when recorded. Omit if none is known; does not assert approval or replacement.

createdBy.description: Creator identity reference. Resolving a provider subject to a shared Entity requires explicit identity mapping.

TypedPlanContent.description: The complete retained plan snapshot for this version, validated against the referenced immutable content schema. The content schema and adequacy criteria must be selected explicitly; source Case.plan_scope plus an execution pin are not assumed sufficient.

schema.description: Version-specific content-schema identifier. Consumers must resolve and validate value against this schema.

value.description: Complete version content under the referenced schema, including applicable planning information. A summary or unresolved pin is not automatically a complete snapshot.

CasePlan.description: An identifiable immutable plan version describing how a Case is to be handled. Every complete version is zn:CasePlan, a subclass of zn:Artifact; there is no separate CasePlanRevision class.

id.description: Distinct immutable version identifier; never reuse it for changed content.

case.description: The stable Case whose handling this plan describes.

sourceEvidence.description: References to retained source records and exact supporting evidence. Migration must preserve all original fields, including provider-specific authority, pins, inputs and carry-forward evidence, whether embedded by the content schema or retained here.

CasePlanSelection.description: Associated Case state, outside immutable plan content. A draft does not replace the current approved version. No new ontology class.

Supersession.description: Associated provenance asserting older-version zn:supersededBy approved-replacement. Write only on approved replacement, outside immutable content. Previous-revision lineage is distinct. No global transitivity or functionality is asserted. Run cancellation is not implied. This is a relationship assertion schema, not a new ontology class.
